status: geometry sized; contact resistance NOT verified; no MPN assigned

contact.status: UNVERIFIED placeholder - measure at first article

output_feasibility.note: 0.1 mohm is only reachable with roughly 20 uohm joints or fewer of them; at 50 uohm each the two joints use the budget up on their own

joint_limit.status: first article must measure every joint at or below per_joint_ohm

input.note: preferred part is a 2-pin 5.08 mm or larger screw terminal; the trace width, not the terminal rating, sets this side

budget_origin: Both PATH_BUDGET_OHM (0.1 mohm, strict) and DESIGN_BASIS_OHM (0.15 mohm) are self-chosen. The project has no output-drop specification; 0.15 is the number the published 92.33 % efficiency already contains, so it is the design basis and sets the joint limit.
caveats: h_conv is a handbook range (4-8 W/m2K), so every rise is a range, not a value
the bar is assumed isothermal; at 80 mm the axial gradient is small but not zero
no radiation term and no forced air; both would lower the rise
contact resistance is a placeholder; at 100 A a 50 uohm joint is 0.5 W on its own
solder-joint and PCB-spreading resistance are not in this model at all
